title: Twodsix Ledger
description: A transaction ledger for the Finances tab of the Twodsix traveller sheet: accounts (Cash, Digital and up to two more), history with filter, search and undo, Pension / Living costs / Ship payments as lists of items you pay by hand, debt as a list of loans, and move money between accounts. Accounts and categories can be set up in the module settings. Also a clearer Inventory tab: carried items first, fire mode buttons, the loaded magazine under each weapon with a low-ammo warning, and Reload with a choice of magazine. Swedish and English.
